turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: Thanks for making the time. I have about twenty minutes and then I have to be somewhere else.

turns.speaker: Me
turns.text: Twenty is plenty. I wanted to walk through the two things you flagged in writing and see which one is actually urgent.

turns.speaker: Speaker 2
turns.text: The reporting one is urgent. The export format is something we can live with until the spring.

turns.speaker: Me
turns.text: Good, that is the answer I was hoping for, because the reporting change is much smaller than it looks.

turns.speaker: Me
turns.text: Days, not weeks. The numbers are already being computed. What is missing is the page that shows them side by side.
